title: Nine Hours and One Screen
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：addict　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 addict 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: By 1996 my brother was ① an addict, my mother said, and he said the word was too big for it. The ② addict, meaning the person and not the machine, sat for nine hours and answered nobody; an addict, she said, is somebody who has agreed to a bargain they did not read. He said the bargain was nine pounds a month.

Every ③ addict she had read about had a drug and a story, and he said he had neither. Their ④ addict — the one they argued about in March — had a nine-page bill and a modem that hummed; an addict, my father said, is the only person in a house whose absence is noticed and whose presence is not. He said the humming stopped in June.

My grandmother said everybody is ⑤ an addict of something, by which she meant tea, and she said that with eleven sugars. The ⑥ addict, meaning the idea and not the person, is nine parts loneliness and one part availability; an addict, my mother said, is somebody who has found a thing that answers faster than people do. She said that was the whole diagnosis.

By 1998 the ⑦ addict had become a subject on the radio and a joke at dinner. The ⑧ addict in the article they read that June was nine years old, and my grandmother said that was the part she could not forgive; an addict, my father said, is either a person who cannot stop or a person nobody has asked to. He said the second is the sadder one.

The ⑨ addict I remember is my brother at nineteen, who came out for food and nothing else. An ⑩ addict, my mother said in 2001, is the only person in a family who is present and absent at the same time; every addict, she said, is somebody waiting for a thing that never says no. She said people say no all the time.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 上瘾者；成瘾的人
B. n. 上瘾者（指人本身，与机器相对）
C. n. 上瘾者（指广播里说的那种、饭桌上的笑话）
D. n. 入迷的人；对……着迷者（比喻义）
E. n. 上瘾者（指抽象概念、这种身份）
F. n. 上瘾者（指家里的那一位）
G. n. 上瘾者（指文章里那一位）
H. n. 上瘾者（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The addict, meaning the person and not the machine
Every addict she had read about
The addict, meaning the idea and not the person
the addict had become a subject on the radio
An addict, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: addict 意为“上瘾者、成瘾的人”，到 1996 年母亲说弟弟是个上瘾的人，他说这个词用得太大了。
addict 指“人本身”，与机器相对，那个上瘾的人一坐九小时，谁叫他都不应。
addict 意为“上瘾者”，她读到过的每一个上瘾者都有一种药和一个故事，他说他两样都没有。
addict 指家里的那一位，他们三月为之争吵的那个上瘾者有一张九页的账单和一台嗡嗡响的调制解调器。
addict 为比喻义，意为“入迷的人、对……着迷者”，祖母说人人都对某样东西上瘾，她指的是茶。
addict 指抽象概念、这种身份，与人相对，是九分孤独加一分可得。
addict 指广播里说的那种、饭桌上的笑话，到 1998 年“上瘾者”成了电台的一个话题和饭桌上的一个笑话。
addict 指文章里那一位，他们那年六月读到的文章里那个上瘾者只有九岁。
addict 意为“上瘾者”，我记得的是十九岁的弟弟，他只为了吃饭才出来，别的都不。
addict 为抽象总称，泛指“上瘾者这类人”，母亲说上瘾者是家里唯一同时在场又不在场的人。
